• *Intensity / action*
• *Waves of enemies*
• *Endlessness / survival*
• *Zombie theme*
Here are a few thematically appropriate icon ideas:

*Infinite Skull*
• A *skull* overlaid with a *looping arrow* or *infinity symbol*
• Signals endless waves of undead and survival pressure
:[USERNAME_25002]:

:skull::[USERNAME_9365]: *Skull with Action Lines / Claw Marks*
• Adds motion/action feel (e.g. slash marks or explosion effect)
• Evokes urgency and danger

:fire: *Flaming Hourglass*
• Symbolizes time pressure + chaos
• Communicates a ticking survival challenge
